title: Varginha records strictly classified at the Ministry of Defense
summary: Aldo Rebello tells of Varginha records strictly classified at the Ministry of Defense, about 1996-present at Brazilian Ministry of Defense, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The information that's held by the Ministry of Defense is strictly classified.

plain: Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian Defense Minister speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says the information the Ministry of Defense holds about the 1996 events in Varginha, a town where many say a craft crashed and a creature was captured, is strictly classified. If true, it means the government has records of the event that the public cannot see.
